item.title: The Cloudflare Blog – Brought to you by EmDash
item.content:encoded: We migrated the Cloudflare Blog to EmDash to prove our stack at massive scale. Here is how we stress-tested performance, safely routed production traffic, and redesigned the frontend experience.

item.title: Say it once: introducing Bot Preference Sync
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare's new Bot Preference Sync automatically aligns your robots.txt file with your AI bot policies for Search, Agent, and Training. Easily manage which bots access your content without maintaining static files.

item.title: From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare OAuth now supports optional scopes, giving users more control over what an app can access and helping developers build secure consent flows around the task at hand.

item.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers
item.content:encoded: In 2024 and 2025, we reassessed remote Spectre attacks on our Workers infrastructure. We share details about the new attack primitives like Spectre gadgets, remote timers, achieving co-location and how new defenses further harden Cloudflare Workers.

item.title: BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234
item.content:encoded: RFC 9234 lets routers reject route leaks on their own, using BGP Roles and the Only to Customer attribute. We measured who has deployed it, and found two Tier 1 networks unexpectedly stripping OTC.

item.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network paths.

item.title: Secure all your internal vibe-coded applications — in one click
item.content:encoded: Introducing Cloudflare Access for Workers. Attach an Access policy directly to a Worker and it applies everywhere that Worker runs — routes, custom domains, workers.dev, and previews — automatically.

item.title: Total eclipse of the Internet: traffic impacts in Iceland, Spain, and Portugal
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare's data shows a clear impact on Internet traffic from Iceland to Spain and Portugal, following the path of totality of the total solar eclipse that occurred on August 12, 2026.

item.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare's Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available. The biggest change: we no longer email you about certificates Cloudflare issued for your domain, so when an alert lands in your inbox, it's worth a look.

item.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks soar as DNS floods and geopolitical tensions drive a new wave
item.content:encoded: In the first half of 2026, Cloudflare detected a 519% surge in hyper-volumetric DDos attacks across its network. These attacks were driven heavily by DNS and CLDAP reflection vectors. This report breaks down how major geopolitical conflicts reshaped the global cyber threat landscape.

item.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
item.content:encoded: Our latest Agents Week has come to a close. Here’s a recap of all the announcements we made from Wallets to Radar.

item.title: Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

item.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. Learn how new good and bad behaviors from bots and agents are assessed by our systems, including BotBase and Precursor — and try out our Precursor Trace simulation to see how your own cursor movements would be assessed as human or bot.

item.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

item.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
item.content:encoded: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

item.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
item.content:encoded: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

item.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
item.content:encoded: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

item.title: The next generation of MCP
item.content:encoded: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

item.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
item.content:encoded: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

item.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
item.content:encoded: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.
